title: Rethink the Role of Neural Decoders in Quantum Error Correction
blockers: Released code contains model, data, compression and training utilities, but no complete Table 1 hardware-calibration/fine-tuning entry point.
The local smoke test validates the released TCN on generated Stim data; it cannot establish Table 1 accuracy.
Upstream pins numpy 2.2.6 with brevitas 0.12.1, which requires numpy <=1.26.4. Local smoke setup uses numpy 1.26.4; this environment deviation is explicit.
SciPy 1.15.3 wheel failed to load on this macOS machine; isolated smoke environment uses SciPy 1.16.3.
evidence_status: published_metrics_verified; no new paper-metric reproduction claimed
